theme: An open day, with travel and a passport deadline on the horizon.
greeting: Good evening, Dan. A wide-open Saturday with the girls at Jen's until tomorrow's handoff - the weight is all in what comes next: the Sunday review at nine, the run to New York, and dinner at Misi.

needsAttention.title: Mike's passport packet is on the clock
needsAttention.detail: Nothing prints today - Mike carries the birth certificates and expired passports through Sunday and Monday travel, landing in Tampa Monday night. The one real print window is Tuesday the 25th: four DS-11s, front-and-back ID copies, and birth-certificate copies in a single sitting, ahead of the Wednesday deadline and Friday's appointment. The State Dept fee (~$400) is check or money order only.

needsAttention.title: Walk the board before the 9 AM review
needsAttention.detail: Mike runs the 15-minute Sunday review tomorrow morning, and it only works if the board is clean going in. Arrive holding the live items: the passport packet, the St. Pete car rental due the 28th, and the Halloween call (St Pete or Maine) due Sept 5.
